hypothesis: On the seven historical D-pass/P-normal-fail pairs, amplitude/phase alone or event windows alone can recover some of the diagnostic bundle benefit.
paper_claim: Field-subset sufficiency on a retrospectively selected cohort, not a population method advantage or phase-only causal effect.
falsifier: Neither subset repairs these cases, or the observed repair actions do not consume the supplied field subset.
schema_changes: Two filtered diagnostic views; no change to physical kernel, service, task, legal domain, model client or episode loop.
targeted_tests: One offline projection check using original cached initial facts, then 14 real model conversations and original full-consumer evaluations.
negative_controls: Original P/D historical results remain reference only; each new arm excludes energy ledger and global minimum active voltage.
stop_condition: Exactly fourteen trajectories, no rescue or extra groups. HTTP500 retry already authorized; retain UNKNOWN/reserve; other missing usage stops paid dependencies.
claim_boundary: Seven pairs are five task IDs, three offset pairs and four nominal pairs. EW adds pre-event single voltage and wake/receive timestamps, not post-event voltage curves. Old work and automations remain paused. No commit/push.
result: PA 5/7, EW 4/7; complementary repairs; two false global exclusions; fourteen normal terminals, no extensions.
checks: Original consumer evaluations plus one cached projection check; independent read-only exposure/outcome/usage readback. No repository-wide health claim.
next_handoff: This ablation is closed. No further experiments, old-task resumes or automations authorized by this package.
